title: t218 CNS-exclusion + WES-restriction + panel-membership for neural enrichment
description: q033 / h12. Recomputes the candidate mutation enrichment and the t217 genomic-span-matched residual p under baseline / CNS-excluded / WES-only / WES+CNS-excluded / panel-only, to separate panel ascertainment (q016) from CNS histology as the source of the t217 residual. Plus per-candidate CNS contribution, leave-one-study-out, panel membership.
